Title: What it returns
Prompt: Explain what this query returns, in order. Do not suggest a rewrite yet. If a column is ambiguous, say so.

Title: Filters
Prompt: List every filter and the rows it removes. Note filters that use functions on columns.

Title: Join risk
Prompt: Say whether each join can multiply rows. Point at the keys. Do not claim the data is clean.
Check: You still check with a count.

Title: Change review
Prompt: I will paste the new query. List behavioural differences. Do not assume indexes exist.

Title: Safer select
Prompt: Rewrite the select list to the columns I name. Do not change the filters.

Title: Comment
Prompt: Write a short comment that says the grain of the result. Do not comment every line.
